section.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Expert answers to common questions about construction, renovation, and our services in New York.

items.question: What areas do you serve in New York?
items.answer: Mega Contracting NY Group proudly serves all five boroughs of New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, and Staten Island), as well as Long Island, Westchester County, and surrounding areas throughout the New York metropolitan region.

items.question: How long does a kitchen renovation take?
items.answer: A kitchen renovation typically takes several weeks depending on the scope of work, materials selected, and required municipal approvals. We provide a tailored schedule during your initial consultation and maintain clear communication through each project milestone.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes, Mega Contracting NY Group is fully licensed and insured in the state of New York. We carry comprehensive commercial general liability insurance and NY State statutory workers' compensation coverage for your protection on every job site.

items.question: Do you handle commercial construction projects?
items.answer: Yes. We handle commercial construction including retail spaces, commercial build-outs, and multi-family residential properties across New York City. Our experienced project managers ensure strict compliance with NYC Building Codes.

items.question: Do you provide free estimates?
items.answer: Yes, we provide free, no-obligation consultations and estimates for all prospective projects. Our estimators visit your property, evaluate requirements, take on-site measurements, and deliver a detailed written scope of work.

items.question: What warranty do you offer?
items.answer: Written warranty terms and coverage are provided with each formal project proposal in accordance with specific material manufacturer guidelines and project scope.

items.question: Can you help with design and permits?
items.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive design-build and project management services. Our team assists with architectural planning, material selection, and coordinates all necessary NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) and Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) permit filings.

items.question: How do I get started with my project?
items.answer: Simply contact our office to schedule an initial consultation. We will discuss your vision, review site conditions, assess project scope, and provide a clear written estimate tailored to your requirements.

items.question: What types of commercial projects do you specialize in?
items.answer: We undertake commercial exterior and interior projects, including multi-family building renovations, retail build-outs, structural concrete, facade maintenance, and flat commercial roofing systems throughout the five boroughs.

items.question: Do you work with historic properties?
items.answer: Yes, we have extensive experience with historic renovations and restorations across NYC. We respect historical architectural details while complying with NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) guidelines and contemporary structural standards.

items.question: Do you provide facade restoration in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, facade restoration is one of our primary masonry services. We perform comprehensive exterior restoration including brick repointing, parapet wall repair, stone restoration, lintel replacement, and exterior waterproofing for residential, multi-family, and commercial properties.

items.question: Can you fix a roof leak in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, we provide prompt roof leak detection and repair services across all five boroughs. Our roofing specialists locate moisture entry points, inspect flashing and membrane seams, and perform durable structural repairs to protect your property from interior water damage.

items.question: What is flat roofing and do you install it in NYC?
items.answer: Flat roofing systems—including modified bitumen, EPDM rubber, and multi-ply built-up roofs—are standard for NYC residential brownstones and commercial structures. We install, repair, and maintain code-compliant flat roofing systems engineered for urban weather conditions.

items.question: Do you handle chimney repair in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, we provide full chimney masonry services in NYC, including brick repointing, chimney rebuilding, flue relining, coping stone installation, and custom flashing repair to eliminate downdrafts and prevent water infiltration.

items.question: What is fire escape painting and certification in NYC?
items.answer: In NYC, property owners must maintain fire escapes in safe, code-compliant condition under local housing codes. We perform scraping, rust-inhibitive priming, high-grade painting, structural iron repairs, and prepare compliance documentation for property owners.

items.question: What is parapet wall repair and when is it needed?
items.answer: Parapet walls are perimeter walls extending above the roofline that endure heavy exposure to wind, rain, and freeze-thaw cycles. Repair is needed when you observe loose brickwork, crumbling mortar, outward leaning, or water intrusion along the roof perimeter.

items.question: Do you do stucco repair in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, we provide exterior stucco repair, re-coating, and complete restoration for residential and commercial facades. We fix hairline cracks, delamination, water staining, and structural damage using weather-resistant stucco systems.

items.question: What is an EIFS contractor and do you provide EIFS in NYC?
items.answer: EIFS (Exterior Insulation and Finish System) is an exterior wall system providing integrated insulation and decorative cladding. We provide professional installation, moisture inspection, and remediation for EIFS systems across NYC.

items.question: Can you handle DOB violation removal in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, we assist NYC property owners with Department of Buildings (DOB) violations. We inspect the cited condition, perform required code-compliant repairs, pull necessary permits, and assemble documentation required for Certificate of Correction filings.

items.question: Do you remove DOT violations and repair sidewalks in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, under NYC administrative code, property owners must maintain sidewalks adjacent to their properties. We handle DOT sidewalk violation repairs, concrete replacement, required permits, and inspection sign-off documentation.

items.question: What is a building safety assessment in NYC?
items.answer: A building safety assessment evaluates exterior facades, parapets, roof membranes, and structural components to identify potential safety hazards, deterioration, and code compliance issues across NYC residential and commercial properties.

items.question: What is brick pointing and do you do it in NYC?
items.answer: Brick pointing (tuckpointing or repointing) removes damaged or weathered mortar from joints between bricks and replaces it with fresh, high-durability mortar. This prevents moisture ingress and protects the structural integrity of your building.

items.question: Do you do foundation repair in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, we handle residential and commercial foundation repair in NYC. Common issues include settling, water intrusion, and surface cracking. Our services include crack injection, waterproofing, and structural reinforcement.

items.question: Are you a waterproofing contractor in NYC?
items.answer: Yes, waterproofing is a vital service in New York. We provide comprehensive waterproofing solutions for rooftops, foundations, exterior masonry walls, and below-grade areas to protect properties against chronic water intrusion.
